title: Daily Market Digest: August 14, 2026
subtitle: Market closes mixed amid inflation relief and retail sales concerns. Not financial advice.

sections.title: Market Pulse: Inflation Relief Meets Retail Headwinds

items.headline: U.S. Markets Trade Mixed; Inflation Cools but Retail Sales Disappoint
items.summary: U.S. equities saw mixed trading today, with major indices fluctuating near record highs. Softer-than-expected inflation data for July eased concerns about an immediate Federal Reserve rate hike, yet a surprising decline in retail sales raised questions about consumer spending and overall economic momentum. Investors are balancing disinflationary signals with signs of slowing growth.

sections.title: Major Indices Performance (As of Midday ET)

items.statContext: Traded lower after a strong Thursday close.

items.headline: Reddit Soars on S&P 500 Inclusion News
items.summary: Shares of Reddit surged following the announcement that it will join the benchmark S&P 500 index on August 18, attracting buying interest from index funds.

items.headline: Nu Holdings Jumps on Robust Earnings
items.summary: Fintech Nu Holdings saw its stock climb after reporting record second-quarter earnings, with quarterly net income surpassing $1 billion for the first time.

items.headline: Eton Pharmaceuticals Rallies on Strong Outlook
items.summary: Eton Pharmaceuticals rallied significantly after reporting a strong quarter and raising its 2026 revenue outlook to over $145 million, with an adjusted EBITDA margin target above 35%.

items.headline: Applied Materials Slides Despite Strong Results
items.summary: Applied Materials stock declined despite the semiconductor equipment maker reporting quarterly revenue and profit that exceeded analysts' expectations, likely due to exceptionally high investor expectations after a significant year-to-date gain.

items.headline: KinderCare Learning Companies Tumble on Disappointing Guidance
items.summary: KinderCare Learning Companies shares tumbled following disappointing second-quarter results and guidance, attributed to center closures.

items.headline: Innventure Inc. Sees Steep Decline
items.summary: Innventure Inc. experienced a substantial drop, making it one of the day's biggest percentage losers.

items.headline: Retail Sales Fall Unexpectedly in July, Sparking Growth Concerns
items.summary: U.S. retail sales for July fell 0.6% to $763.6 billion, missing economists' forecasts for a 0.1% increase. This data, coupled with last week's weak employment report, has fueled fears that the U.S. economy may be losing momentum.

items.headline: Cooling Inflation Data Reduces Likelihood of September Fed Rate Hike
items.summary: The Producer Price Index (PPI) for July remained unchanged, defying expectations for a rise, and follows benign consumer inflation data earlier in the week. These disinflationary signals have led markets to price in a 69% probability that the Federal Reserve will keep its benchmark rate steady next month.

items.headline: Technology and Communication Services Lead Gains, Energy and Materials Lag
items.summary: On Thursday, the Technology and Communication Services sectors were notable leaders, each gaining approximately 1%. Conversely, today saw selling pressure in the Energy and Oil & Gas sectors, partly due to volatile oil prices and ongoing Middle East tensions. The Materials sector also experienced declines.

items.headline: Oil Prices Fluctuate Amid Middle East Tensions
items.summary: Oil prices showed relative stability today after recent sharp swings. Brent crude was around $87 per barrel, impacted by U.S. plans to levy economic measures against Iran and maintain a naval blockade at the Strait of Hormuz.

items.headline: Key Companies Report Strong Earnings, AI Demand Continues to Drive Performance
items.summary: Several companies reported strong quarterly results, including Nu Holdings ($NU), Eton Pharmaceuticals ($ETON), and EnerSys ($ENS). Boost Run Inc. announced substantial new contracts totaling $1.9 billion, projecting $400 million in Annual Recurring Revenue by fiscal year-end, leveraging its NVIDIA Preferred Cloud Provider status. Outlook Therapeutics ($OTLK) also highlighted FDA approval of LYTENAVA. The overall AI investment boom continues to support corporate earnings and economic growth.
